entrance: Through the two doors on the western wall of the central courtyard of Dire Maul. One player needs the Crescent Key from Dire Maul East.

7482.objective: Find Kariel Winthalus in Dire Maul. Click his Skeletal Remains next to Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum and choose to mourn him.
7482.note: Scholar Runethorn walks the road through Feathermoon Stronghold, so look around. The boat to Feathermoon leaves from the Forgotten Coast on the west shore of Feralas.

7481.objective: Find Kariel Winthalus in Dire Maul. Click his Skeletal Remains next to Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum and choose to mourn him.
7481.note: Sage Korolusk walks the road through Camp Mojache, so look around.

7461.objective: Shut down the five pylons, then kill Immol'thar and Prince Tortheldrin.
7461.note: The Shen'dralar Ancient stands on the bridge in the upper level of the Court of the Highborne. Go back to him after the kills for the next quest.

7877.objective: Open the Treasure of the Shen'dralar under the ramp in the Athenaeum and take your reward.
7877.note: Follows The Madness Within and cannot be shared.
